reviewPlanApplied.secondMessageCriterion: Directly coherent second message without omitted/substituted words, additional decoding or arbitrary selected substring. Ordinary cover-prose fragments and isolated thematic words are insufficient.
reviewPlanApplied.instructionCriterion: A concrete action and target/unit/source anchor must be stated, without filling gaps.
reviewPlanApplied.positiveHandling: Keep potential message/key-looking material private; a follow-up needs a separate fixed protocol.

reviewPlanApplied.nonrecognitionScope: Subjective AI nonrecognition, not a formal message, key, article or cipher-family exclusion.
reviewPlanApplied.inconclusive: Pin/source failure, incomplete reading or unresolved reviewer disagreement.
prohibitedFollowups: No additional transforms, selected substrings, word deletions or substitutions.
